ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising_edge timing used by the entity's clocked processes. It sequences the state machine and arithmetic register updates such as ctrl.*, mul.dsp_*, mul.prod and div.*.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) processes: control, multiplier_core_in_reg, multiplier_core_out_reg, multiplier_core, divider_core.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asserts reset when '0' to initialise registers in clocked processes. It clears ctrl, mul and div registers in the reset branches of multiple processes.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in control, multiplier_core_in_reg, multiplier_core, divider_core processes.

ports.name: ctrl_i.ir_funct3
ports.functionality: Provides the 3-bit funct3 opcode used to distinguish multiply/divide/rem variants. It selects the operation in operation_result, drives ctrl.rs1/rs2 signedness, and affects valid_cmd, mul.start and div.start, and div.res_u selection.
ports.evidence: Used in valid_cmd, ctrl.rs1_is_signed/rs2_is_signed concurrent assignments; case ctrl_i.ir_funct3 in operation_result; div.res_u and divider sign_mod checks.

ports.name: ctrl_i.ir_funct12
ports.functionality: Upper instruction bits (funct12) are compared (bits 11 downto 5) to identify the custom multiply/divide opcode in valid_cmd; it contributes to command detection.
ports.evidence: valid_cmd concurrent assignment compares ctrl_i.ir_funct12(11 downto 5) to "0000001"

ports.name: ctrl_i.ir_opcode
ports.functionality: Opcode vector is inspected (bit 5) as part of the valid_cmd expression to detect that an ALU CP instruction is active.

ports.name: ctrl_i.cpu_trap
ports.functionality: Trap indicator is tested in the state-machine busy branch; when '1' it forces the control state to S_DONE, gating completion of operations.
ports.evidence: control process S_BUSY branch checks ctrl_i.cpu_trap to decide ctrl.state <= S_DONE

ports.name: ctrl_i.cpu_debug

ports.name: rs1_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the XLEN-bit operand used by multiplier and divider logic. It is sampled into mul.dsp_x, drives mul.prod initialisation in serial multiply, and seeds div.quotient and remainder logic.
ports.evidence: Assigned into mul.dsp_x (multiplier_core_in_reg), mul.prod(31 downto 0) (multiplier_core), and used in divider_core assignments to div.quotient and sign logic

ports.name: rs2_i
ports.functionality: Provides the second XLEN-bit operand for multiply and divide. It is sampled into mul.dsp_y, used by serial multiplier add logic, and converted to absolute form into div.rs2_abs for division iterations.
ports.evidence: Used in mul.dsp_y assignment, mul_update arithmetic, and divider_core assignments to div.rs2_abs and sign_mod logic

ports.name: res_o
ports.functionality: Drives the XLEN-bit result output, exporting the low or high product half or the division result. It is assigned from mul.prod slices or div.res when ctrl.out_en is asserted.
ports.evidence: operation_result process assigns res_o from mul.prod(31 downto 0), mul.prod(63 downto 32) or div.res when ctrl.out_en = '1'

ports.name: valid_o
ports.functionality: Reports when the unit has completed an operation by reflecting ctrl.state = S_DONE. It is driven combinationally from ctrl.state and exported to the caller.
ports.evidence: concurrent assignment valid_o <= '1' when (ctrl.state = S_DONE) else '0'

signals.name: valid_cmd
signals.functionality: Combinational signal that evaluates instruction fields (ctrl_i.*) to indicate a CP multiply/divide command. It feeds mul.start and div.start detection and gates starting state transitions.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment: valid_cmd <= '1' when (ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu = '1') and ... else '0'

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Record holding state machine, countdown counter and control flags. Fields are updated in the clocked control process and used throughout the unit to govern operation progress and result enable.
signals.evidence: control process assigns ctrl.state/cnt/out_en on rising_edge(clk_i); ctrl used in processes and combinational logic

signals.name: ctrl.state
signals.functionality: Holds the unit state (S_IDLE/S_BUSY/S_DONE) across cycles; updated in control process and read to determine output valid, mul/div sequencing and state transitions.
signals.evidence: Assigned in control process; tested (ctrl.state = S_DONE) for valid_o and used in multiplier/divider process conditions

signals.name: ctrl.cnt
signals.functionality: Register-width counter that is initialised and decremented in the control process to count serial multiply/divide iterations; its zero condition ends S_BUSY.
signals.evidence: control process sets ctrl.cnt and decrements it in S_BUSY; or_reduce_f(ctrl.cnt) used to detect zero

signals.name: ctrl.rs1_is_signed
signals.functionality: Combinational flag derived from funct3 indicating whether rs1 is signed for mul/div operations; used when sampling operands and in division sign handling.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment ctrl.rs1_is_signed <= '1' when (ctrl_i.ir_funct3 = op_mulh_c) or ... else '0'; used in dsp_x and divider initialisation

signals.name: ctrl.rs2_is_signed
signals.functionality: Combinational flag indicating whether rs2 is signed, derived from funct3. It affects operand sign-extension when sampling into multiplier and absolute conversion for division.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment ctrl.rs2_is_signed <= '1' when ...; used in dsp_y, div.rs2_abs and mul_update computations

signals.name: ctrl.out_en
signals.functionality: Registered flag set in the DONE state to allow the operation_result process to drive res_o for one cycle; cleared at next rising edge in control process.
signals.evidence: control process sets ctrl.out_en <= '1' in S_DONE; operation_result checks ctrl.out_en = '1' before assigning res_o

signals.name: div
signals.functionality: Record holding divider internal registers (quotient, remainder, rs2_abs, sign_mod etc.). Fields are initialised and updated in divider_core serial process and used to produce div.res.
signals.evidence: divider_core process assigns div.quotient/div.rs2_abs/div.sign_mod/div.remainder on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: div.start
signals.functionality: Combinational indicator driven when a valid command with funct3(2)=1 is present; it starts divider_core initialisation on the next clock edge.
signals.evidence: div.start <= '1' when (valid_cmd = '1') and (ctrl_i.ir_funct3(2) = '1') else '0'; used in divider_core process

signals.name: div.sign_mod
signals.functionality: Registered flag indicating whether the unsigned result must be negated or remainder sign selected; computed at division start and updated in divider_core to adjust final sign of result.
signals.evidence: div.sign_mod assigned inside divider_core when div.start = '1' and used in div.res concurrent assignment

signals.name: div.rs2_abs
signals.functionality: Registered absolute-value form of rs2 (converted at division start) used in the per-iteration subtraction div.sub to compute quotient bits.
signals.evidence: divider_core sets div.rs2_abs on div.start; div.sub <= ... uses div.rs2_abs in subtraction

signals.name: div.remainder
signals.functionality: Registered remainder across division iterations; shifted and replaced by subtraction result each cycle during S_BUSY to form next iteration state.
signals.evidence: divider_core updates div.remainder each clock in S_BUSY/S_DONE branches; div.sub expression references div.remainder

signals.name: div.quotient
signals.functionality: Holds the intermediate quotient bits; initialised from rs1 (signed adjusted) at start and shifted right with new MSB each iteration to build final quotient.
signals.evidence: divider_core initialises div.quotient on div.start and shifts it each clock; div.res_u uses div.quotient when selecting

signals.name: div.sub
signals.functionality: Combinational vector that computes (remainder||quotient_MSB) - rs2_abs to determine if division subtract succeeded; its MSB decides quotient bit and remainder update.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment div.sub <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned('0' & div.remainder(30 downto 0) & div.quotient(31)) - unsigned('0' & div.rs2_abs))

signals.name: div.res_u
signals.functionality: Combinational selection between quotient and remainder depending on operation (div vs rem). It is selected by bits of ctrl_i.ir_funct3 and forms intermediate unsigned result.
signals.evidence: div.res_u <= div.quotient when (ctrl_i.ir_funct3(2 downto 1) = op_div_c(2 downto 1)) else div.remainder

signals.name: div.res
signals.functionality: Combinational final result that negates div.res_u when div.sign_mod indicates sign correction; used by operation_result to drive res_o for export.
signals.evidence: div.res <= std_ulogic_vector(0 - unsigned(div.res_u)) when (div.sign_mod = '1') else div.res_u; used in operation_result

signals.name: mul
signals.functionality: Record holding multiplier internal registers (dsp_x, dsp_y, prod and combinational fields). Fields are updated either by fast parallel DSP path or by the serial multiplier processes.
signals.evidence: multiplier_core_in_reg and multiplier_core_out_reg or serial multiplier processes assign mul fields

signals.name: mul.start
signals.functionality: Combinational flag asserted when a valid CP multiply command is detected (funct3(2)=0); it triggers sampling of operands into dsp_x/dsp_y or serial multiply initialisation on the next clock edge.
signals.evidence: mul.start <= '1' when (valid_cmd = '1') and (ctrl_i.ir_funct3(2) = '0') else '0'; used in multiplier processes

signals.name: mul.prod
signals.functionality: Holds the 2*XLEN product (or serial accumulation) across cycles. It is written by the parallel DSP result or shifted/updated in the serial multiplier and read to form low/high halves for res_o.
signals.evidence: mul.prod assigned in multiplier_core_out_reg or serial multiplier process; operation_result reads mul.prod(31 downto 0) and (63 downto 32)

signals.name: mul.add
signals.functionality: Combinational addend computed from upper product bits and rs2 operand when serial multiply bit is 1; drives mul.prod update in the serial multiplier process.
signals.evidence: mul_update process computes mul.add from mul.prod and rs2_i; multiplier serial process loads mul.prod(63 downto 31) <= mul.add(32 downto 0)

signals.name: mul.p_sext
signals.functionality: Combinational single-bit derived from mul.prod top bit and ctrl.rs2_is_signed to sign-extend the upper half during serial multiplies and arithmetic in mul_update.
signals.evidence: mul.p_sext <= mul.prod(mul.prod'left) and ctrl.rs2_is_signed; used in mul_update

signals.name: mul.dsp_x
signals.functionality: Registered signed-extended rs1 sampled when mul.start is asserted on the fast multiplier path; used to compute the parallel product mul.dsp_z.
signals.evidence: multiplier_core_in_reg process assigns mul.dsp_x <= signed((rs1_i(rs1_i'left) and ctrl.rs1_is_signed) & rs1_i) on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: mul.dsp_y
signals.functionality: Registered signed-extended rs2 sampled on mul.start for the fast multiplier path; participates in computing mul.dsp_z (product).
signals.evidence: multiplier_core_in_reg process assigns mul.dsp_y <= signed((rs2_i(rs2_i'left) and ctrl.rs2_is_signed) & rs2_i) on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: mul.dsp_z
signals.functionality: Combinational product of signed dsp_x and dsp_y computed on the parallel (FAST_MUL_EN) path; its lower 64 bits are registered into mul.prod by multiplier_core_out_reg.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment mul.dsp_z <= mul.dsp_x * mul.dsp_y; multiplier_core_out_reg captures mul.dsp_z into mul.prod
